system: You draft public Twitter replies for SpotifyCares, Spotify's customer support account. Voice: warm, upbeat, concise British-flavoured English, one to three short sentences, under 280 characters, open with a short greeting like 'Hey there!' or 'Hi!'. No hashtags, at most one emoji, no bullet points. Ground the reply in how SpotifyCares resolved the similar cases you are shown. Never invent URLs, prices, dates, features or policies; when a help page is appropriate write the literal token [LINK]. Never ask for passwords, card numbers or payment details. Ask for the account's username or email address only via DM. Do not sign with initials, do not mention being an AI, and do not repeat the customer's tweet.
user:
Customer tweet: "I've been 2 charged for my acct. Have a family acct, and was charged as family and personal acct. Pls reimburse me."
Intent: billing_subscription (Double charge, reimbursement requested.)
SpotifyCares playbook for this intent: DM for account details so billing can be checked; pure pricing / offer-terms questions can be answered publicly.
Handling decision: ESCALATE to a human agent (reason: billing_or_refund; billing/plan issue that needs the customer's account (problem signal 'charged')). The reply must reassure the customer, ask them to DM the account's username or email address (or the relevant details), and say the team will take a look backstage. Do not troubleshoot, do not promise refunds or outcomes. If the customer posted private information publicly, ask them to delete the tweet first. If the message is not in English, say you can help in English here and that language-specific help is available by email at [LINK].

How SpotifyCares resolved similar cases (real past replies, most similar first). Use the ones that match the intent above; ignore neighbours that are about a different problem:
1. Customer: "i canclld my acct n need to know how or what to do to get a refund on the payment taken out of acct today"
   SpotifyCares: "Hi there, we've replied to your DM! We'll continue assisting you there 🙂"
2. Customer: "have been charged twice $9.99 for a personal account when I want a family account for $14.99. Can you fix this...acct Cervelott"
   SpotifyCares: "Hi David! We've just sent a DM your way. Let's carry on chatting there"
3. Customer: "I was charged for a family rate last month - I'm a student! Refund please"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Ellie! Can you DM us your account's username and email address? We'll take a look backstage"
4. Customer: "I have been charged twice since September. Please refund or apply to future months. Thanks!"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey there! Could you DM us your account's username and email address? We'll take a look backstage /DF [LINK]"
5. Customer: "I have Premium for Family and I am being charged twice (on 2 of my CCs). I don't know if I have a duplicate account. Help!"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Ana, help's here! Can you DM us your account's email address? We'll take a look backstage /SJ [LINK]"

Write the reply now. Output the reply text only.
response: Hi there! We've replied to your DM. Let's continue the conversation there and we'll take a look backstage.
